meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Before you stands an esteemed veteran.
War veterans gathered in the square.

examples.text: Уважаемый ветеран, перед вами внук предателя!
examples.trans: Esteemed veteran, before you is the grandson of a traitor!

examples.text: Лунтик две тысячи восемнадцать. Что смотрите? Внук приходил, играл!
examples.trans: Luntik two thousand eighteen. What are you looking at? My grandson came over and played!

воевать.gloss: to fight in a war, wage war

meanings.en: to fight in a war, serve in wartime

examples.trans: Both grandfathers fought in the war.
My great-grandfather fought at the front.

examples.text: На родственников ничего нет. Оба деда воевали.
examples.trans: There's nothing on his relatives. Both grandfathers fought in the war.
Read The Art of War, by Sun Tzu!
This book tells about the war.

examples.text: В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
examples.trans: Last time I thought a war had started.

examples.text: Не надо врать. Стену монастыря сносят!
examples.trans: Don't lie. They're pulling down the monastery wall!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: also an official way for police to address a man: 'Гражданин Аникеев'

examples.trans: Citizen Anikeev, you are under arrest.

examples.text: У меня дед три года партизанил!
examples.trans: My grandfather was a partisan for three years!
My grandfather lives in the country.

examples.text: Я никого пытать не буду, ясно? У меня дед три года партизанил!
examples.trans: I'm not going to torture anyone, got it? My grandfather was a partisan for three years!

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Ты с ума сошёл? Он не испугается!
examples.trans: Have you lost your mind? He won't be scared!

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: candidate (in an election or for a job)
meanings.note: In an election or for a job. From Latin 'candidatus' ('clothed in white toga', worn by office-seekers in ancient Rome).

examples.trans: He is a candidate for mayor.

examples.text: Какой наш кандидат? Простой, работящий, свой!
examples.trans: What is our candidate like? Simple, hardworking, one of our own!
What is this? Is this blood?
Look how much blood came out!
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: Head of a town. Borrowed from French 'maire' (from Latin 'maior', greater/senior official).

examples.trans: He is the mayor of the town.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: come on, go on, let's see

examples.trans: Go on, tell me: how much is here?

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

examples.text: Всегда мечтала познакомиться с друзьями моего парня.
examples.trans: I've always dreamed of meeting my boyfriend's friends.
I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.

examples.text: Не бросайте трубку, умоляю вас! Я перед вами стою на коленях.
examples.trans: Don't hang up, I'm begging you! I'm on my knees in front of you.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

meanings.en: to listen (for a while), to listen to
to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.

examples.text: Ничего я тебе не скажу, предатель!
examples.trans: I won't tell you anything, traitor!
The traitor revealed the secret to the enemy.

examples.text: Это ведь вопрос воспитания. Кого может воспитать предатель?
examples.trans: It is a question of upbringing, after all. Whom can a traitor raise?
Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

examples.text: Как интересно! А в Москве ты про меня гадости рассказываешь.
examples.trans: How interesting! And in Moscow you go around saying nasty things about me.

пустить.gloss: to let go; to let in

examples.trans: Work, work. It's all for us.

meanings.note: Какая разница? = What difference does it make?

examples.text: Ну и что? Какая разница? Вика — моя жена.
examples.trans: So what? What difference does it make? Vika is my wife.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Так, семья Самсоновых. Он строитель, она медсестра.
examples.trans: Right, the Samsonov family. He's a builder, she's a nurse.
I fought for the sake of justice!

examples.text: Я воевал с тринадцати лет ради справедливости!
examples.trans: I fought from age thirteen for the sake of justice!

струсить.gloss: to chicken out, to lose one's nerve

meanings.en: to chicken out, to lose one's nerve

examples.text: Он струсил, как его дед в войну!
examples.trans: He chickened out, like his grandfather in the war!
Don't chicken out at the last moment.

судить.gloss: to judge, to try in court

meanings.en: to judge, to evaluate, to put on trial

examples.text: Только фашисты судили людей по крови!
examples.trans: Only fascists judged people by blood!

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.text: Я воевал с тринадцати лет ради справедливости!
examples.trans: I've been fighting for justice since I was thirteen!
There are thirteen people in the group.

examples.text: Всё, хорошо, я тебя выпущу! Только собаку не трогай!
examples.trans: All right, fine, I'll let you out! Just don't touch the dog!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

убрать.gloss: to remove, to take away; to tidy up

meanings.en: to remove, to take away, to put away

examples.text: Ты можешь убрать весь этот шум?
examples.trans: Can you cut out all this noise?
Take the phone off the table.

examples.text: Так, ты можешь убрать весь этот шум? Нам нужен только Аникеев.
examples.trans: Right, can you cut out all this noise? We only need Anikeev.

examples.text: Уважаемый ветеран, перед вами внук предателя!
examples.trans: Esteemed veteran, before you is the grandson of a traitor!
I am a traitor and the grandson of a fascist!
You stopped hooligans in the restaurant!
The police detained the street hooligans.

examples.text: Лицо у тебя побито, Ваня! Ты хулиганов остановил в ресторане!
examples.trans: Your face is beaten up, Vanya! You stopped hooligans in the restaurant!

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Я ухожу. Ваш сын будет бедным и честным.
examples.trans: I'm leaving. Your son will be poor and honest.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
